_comment: Traditional Chinese texts for the German table bond. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_TW.

strings.Bonding step 2: Pick Bond. A big Mine! b: 羈絆第2步：選擇羈絆。會出現一個大大的“歸我！”按鈕。
strings.Bonding step 3: Press A as fast as you c: 羈絆第3步：儘快連按A。槽越滿，羈絆越好。
strings.Bonding step 3: Tap Mine! as fast as you: 羈絆第3步：儘快連點“歸我！”。槽越滿，羈絆越好。
strings.Mine: tap one button fast. Echo: repeat: 歸我：快速連點一個按鈕。回聲：重複呼喚。
